items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who did Henry Sino play with, you said? Now you saw him with him. With Ridgely. [INTERVIEWEE] Ridgely.

ctx.x: I played the first dance with him, when the first, second week after school opened. We all played, but last Saturday before last, while I was playing down there, you see, for your own. So you got Sun White to play.
Can I run you out of the room for a few minutes? I'll talk to him about Steve Lewis. Hi. Oh, who did Henry Sino play with?
He put my stuff on. Oh, that little, yeah, okay.
